QUESTIONS PARTNERS ASK

Answers before you refer your first client.

Will Jwero replace the ERP/billing software I sell or support?

No, that’s the point. Jwero explicitly bridges to Tally, Zoho Books and existing billing systems rather than replacing them. You keep the ledger relationship; Jwero adds the customer-and-channel layer your clients don’t have today.

How new is this partner program?

Honestly new, we’re building it with the first handful of partners now, not running a mature channel with hundreds of dealers. If you want in early, terms and support are worked out directly with you, rather than read off a rigid tier sheet.

What do partners actually get?

Referral terms discussed directly per relationship, we won’t publish a number here we might have to walk back. What we can promise: your clients stay yours, we don’t go around you, and you’re looped in on the account.

I’m an accountant, not a software dealer, does this fit me?

Yes, accountants and consultants who already advise jewellery businesses are one of the two groups this program is built for. You see the operational gaps client by client; a referral is often just naming what you’ve already noticed.

Is there a formal contract or certification process?

Not a heavy one at this stage, a conversation, a shared understanding of how referrals are tracked and credited, and we go from there. We’d rather start simple and add structure only once it’s needed.

What happens after I refer a business?

We run the same honest evaluation we’d run with any prospect: pilot first, real data, no pressure, and keep you informed of where it stands. If it doesn’t fit, we’ll say so rather than push a bad deployment that reflects badly on your referral.
